pr_body:
<!-- Hey there. Thank you so much for improving NewPipe, and filling out the details. Having roughly the same layout helps everyone considerably :)-->

#### What is it?
- [x] Bugfix (user facing)
- [ ] Feature (user facing)
- [ ] Codebase improvement (dev facing)
- [ ] Meta improvement to the project (dev facing)

#### Description of the changes in your PR
<!-- While bullet points are the norm in this section, feel free to write free-form text instead of a list -->
This PR 
- adds a filter to the import FilePicker, so that only zip files are shown (no more possible to pick a wrong type)
- adds the method `isValidBackupFile` to `ContentsettingsManager` (in short: checks whether the zip has exactly 2 files and whether they're the necessary ones)
- shows a `SnackBar` if the zip is invalid with the action "Show info" which throws `onError` (that the zip file wasn't created by NewPipe)

#### Fixes the following issue(s)
<!-- Also add any other links relevant to your change. -->
- fixes #5055 

#### Due diligence
- [x] I read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).
pr_title: Add check for valid zip contents during import

In fact, the import procedure is wrapped inside a `try-catch`-block, so every exception should be caught, but unfortunately the app just freezes and restarts without an error screen.

```java
public static Snackbar make(@NonNull View view, @NonNull CharSequence text, @Duration int duration)
```
I just looked into the implementation and the method calls `setDuration`. It should work :)
Wouldn't the error screen only show the exception that is thrown here without any additional information?
The additional info is that the zip file is not created by NewPipe as you can see. The SnackBar text itself shows that the zip is not supported, the exception gives some more information (reason).

Can't that be also squeazed into the snackbar, since only a single line of text?

Besides that: Since the message is intented for users and not developers, it needs to be translatable
